title: EHBP conformance normalized result
description: The single JSON object an adapter emits per fixture. The harness asserts equality over the ASSERTED fields across all languages and against the fixture expectation. native_error is captured for humans and MUST NOT be asserted.

fixture_id.description: Echo of the fixture id this result answers.

outcome.description: ok = operation completed (including a spec-sanctioned pass-through). error = a protocol/crypto/input failure. skipped = this fixture is not observable in this runner (see skip_reason); NEVER used to avoid a hard case.

error_code.description: ASSERTED. Canonical code from conformance/spec/errors.md. Required when outcome=error, must be null otherwise.

status.description: ASSERTED when present. HTTP status for e2e fixtures; null for in-process crypto/config fixtures.

response_headers.description: ASSERTED (normalized subset only, see harness). Lowercased header names the harness cares about after any client-side header stripping: ehbp-response-nonce, content-length, transfer-encoding, content-type. Presence/absence matters; content-length and transfer-encoding MUST be absent on a decrypted response body.

body_hex.description: ASSERTED. Lowercase hex of the bytes delivered to the caller: the decrypted plaintext on success, or the pass-through body on a sanctioned pass-through. null when there is no body or the operation is not body-producing.

passthrough.description: ASSERTED. true when the body is an unauthenticated pass-through (non-2xx, no nonce), NOT decrypted application data. Distinguishes a sanctioned plaintext error from a real decrypted body so the two can never be conflated.

plaintext_emitted_before_error.description: ASSERTED. Fail-closed check: did ANY authenticated plaintext reach the consumer before this result errored? MUST be false on error fixtures unless the fixture explicitly expects otherwise.

bytes_emitted_before_error.description: ASSERTED. Count of plaintext bytes delivered before the error. MUST be 0 on error fixtures unless explicitly expected.

skip_reason.description: Required when outcome=skipped. Machine-readable reason, e.g. 'browser-coalesces-duplicate-headers' or 'no-randomness-hook'.

native_error.description: NOT ASSERTED. The raw native error type and message, for human audit and the mapping table.

runner.description: NOT ASSERTED. Which adapter produced this (e.g. 'rust', 'js-browser:firefox'). For the report only.
